text:
As Shire Plc (SHPG) Stock Rose, Marshall Wace Llp Has Trimmed Its Stake Posted by James Guidry on January 21, 2019 at 4:53 pm
Marshall Wace Llp decreased its stake in Shire Plc (SHPG) by 10.08% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marshall Wace Llp sold 54,312 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.27% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 484,392 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $74.11M, down from 538,704 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marshall Wace Llp who had been investing in Shire Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $163.90 billion market cap company. It closed at $179.2 lastly. It is down 18.67% since January 21, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.67% the S&P500.
Marshall Wace Llp, which manages about $2.15B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 20,148 shares to 44,039 shares, valued at $6.78 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Brocade Comm Sys (NASDAQ:BRCD) by 624,193 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.78M shares, and has risen its stake in Zoetis Inc (NYSE:ZTS).
Analysts await Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) to report earnings on February, 13. They expect $3.77 earnings per share, down 5.28 % or $0.21 from last year’s $3.98 per share. SHPG’s profit will be $3.45B for 11.88 P/E if the $3.77 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.64 actual earnings per share reported by Shire plc for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 3.57 % EPS growth.
